about.title: About us
about.statement: To us, fireworks are an art. For over 19 years we have created pyrotechnic shows for weddings, parties and large-scale events, to Western standards.

facts.text: Of experience in indoor, outdoor and ground shows.

facts.title: Licensed team

facts.text: Pyromusical shows, with every shot synced to the track you choose.

facts.title: Smokeless, indoors
facts.text: Smokeless indoor fireworks for the venue, the cake or the first dance.

services.title: Services
services.intro: Four ways to light up an event.

exterior.title: Outdoor fireworks
exterior.text: Light shows in the sky, from 20 to 100 metres high. For weddings, christenings, birthdays and large-scale events.

interior.title: Indoor fireworks
interior.text: Smokeless spark fountains for the venue, the cake or the first dance. Colour and surprise without leaving the party.

ground.title: Ground fireworks
ground.text: Spark fountains, pyrotechnic waterfalls and glowing hearts for the stage, the couple's entrance or themed moments.

effects.title: Special effects
effects.text: Heavy smoke, flames, confetti, soap bubbles and lights for events, stage, theatre and film.

weddings.title: Weddings and christenings
weddings.text: The couple's entrance, the first dance, the cake and the end of the night.

corporate.title: Corporate events
corporate.text: Launches, galas and company parties, with every moment planned.

cities.title: Cities and festivals
cities.text: New Year's Eve, city days and festivals, in the open sky.

privacy.metaDescription: What the quote form collects, why, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.draft: Draft: this text must be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Piromania International SRL is the controller of your data. You can reach us at office@piromania.ro or on 0722 380 636. [To complete: company ID (CUI), trade register number, registered address.]

sections.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Only what you send through the quote form: your name, phone, email (optional), the type, date and town of the event, and any details you add. We don't use analytics or advertising cookies. The only cookie we set remembers the language you picked.

sections.title: Why we use it
paragraphs: To answer your request and send you a quote. The legal basis is taking steps at your request before entering into a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR). We don't send newsletters and we never sell your data.

sections.title: Who can see it
paragraphs: The Piromania team, and the providers that help us deliver your message: Resend (sending the email) and Vercel (hosting the site). They may process data outside the EU under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: For as long as we discuss the quote and, if you become a client, for the contract and our legal obligations. Requests that don't lead to a contract are deleted after at most 12 months. [To confirm with the client.]

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask to access, correct or delete your data, restrict or object to its processing, and to receive it in a portable format. Email office@piromania.ro. You can also complain to the Romanian data protection authority (ANSPDCP), dataprotection.ro.
